```{r}


# Required packages
#install.packages(c("httr","jsonlite","tidyverse","lubridate","scales","fredr"))

library(httr); 
library(jsonlite); 
library(tidyverse); 
library(lubridate); 
library(scales); 
library(fredr)
```

```{r}

# ---------- USER: set API KEYS ----------

CENSUS_KEY <- # use personal census key  # Census key
fredr_set_key (" # Use FRED key")  

# ---------- PARAMETERS ----------
hs6 <- "720839"                # HS6 heading for hot-rolled steel (720839)
hs4 <- "7208"                 # HS6 heading for flat-rolled steeel (7208)

# ---------- 1) Pull Census monthly import data (general imports) ----------
# Query variables: GEN_VAL_MO (general imports total value monthly), GEN_QY1_MO (general imports qty1 monthly), MONTH

library(httr)


base <- "https://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs"
vars <- "GEN_VAL_MO,CON_QY1_MO,MONTH,COMM_LVL,I_COMMODITY"





# ---------- PARAMETERS ----------
hs4 <- "7208"                        # HS4 code for flat-rolled steel
start_ym <- "2018-01"                # start month
end_ym <- "2025-11"# latest month
library(lubridate)
months <- seq(ymd(paste0(start_ym,"-01")), ymd(paste0(end_ym,"-01")), by = "months")
months_str <- format(months, "%Y-%m")




 # Create a list of all months from 2018 to 2025
months_2018_2025 <- format(seq(as.Date("2018-01-01"), as.Date("2025-11-01"), by = "month"), "%Y-%m")

 # Initialize an empty list to store the data
all_data <- list()


   # Loop through each month and make an API request
   for (month in months_2018_2025) {
       qs <- list(
           get = vars,
           COMM_LVL = "HS4",
           I_COMMODITY = "7208", 
           time = month,
           key = CENSUS_KEY
        )
      req_url <- modify_url(base, query = qs)
       res <- GET(req_url)
       stop_for_status(res)
       dat <- content(res, as = "parsed")
       
   # Extract the data rows, skipping the header row
         if (length(dat) > 1) {
             data_rows <- dat[-1]
             all_data[[month]] <- data_rows
           }
     }

   # Combine all data into a single data frame
   combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_data)
   
   str(combined_data)
   
 
 # combined_data is a list of lists, each inner list has 8 elements
 # Define column names
 col_names <- c("GeneralValue", "ConsumptionQuantity", "MonthNum", "CommodityLevel",
                "CommodityID", "SourceCommodityLevel", "SourceCommodityID", "Time")
 
 # Convert each inner list to a data.frame row
 df_list <- lapply(combined_data, function(x) {
   as.data.frame(t(unlist(x)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)  # transpose to make a row
 })
 
 # Combine all rows into one data.frame
 result_df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
 
 # Set column names
 colnames(result_df) <- col_names
 
 # Convert numeric columns
 result_df <- result_df %>%
   mutate(
     GeneralValue = as.numeric(GeneralValue),
     ConsumptionQuantity = as.numeric(ConsumptionQuantity)
   )
 
 # View
 head(result_df)
 tail(result_df)



# ---------- 2) Clean and transform ----------

 
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

dat <- result_df %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert "YYYY-MM" to "YYYY-MM-01" and then to Date
    MONTH = ymd(paste0(Time, "-01")),
    import_value = as.numeric(GeneralValue),
    import_qty1 = as.numeric(ConsumptionQuantity),
    unit_value = ifelse(import_qty1 > 0, import_value / import_qty1, NA)
  ) %>%
  select(MONTH, import_value, import_qty1, unit_value) %>%
  arrange(MONTH)

head(dat)



```

#====PPI of Steel Mill Products ===#
```{r}



# ---------- 2) Get domestic PPI from FRED ----------
ppi_fred_id <- "WPU1017"   # Steel Mill Products (commodity) on FRED
ppi <- fredr(series_id = ppi_fred_id,
             observation_start = ym(paste0(start_ym)),
             observation_end   = Sys.Date()) %>%
  transmute(MONTH = as_date(date), ppi = value)

# ---------- 3) Merge and index to Jan 2017 = 100 ----------
start_base <- ymd(paste0(start_ym, "-01"))
# compute index base values
unit_base <- dat %>% filter(MONTH == start_base) %>% pull(unit_value) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)
ppibase   <- ppi %>% filter(MONTH == start_base) %>% pull(ppi) 

dat2 <- dat %>%
  left_join(ppi, by = "MONTH") %>%
  mutate(unit_index = (unit_value / unit_base) * 100,
         ppi_index  = (ppi / ppibase) * 100,
         import_value_m = import_value / 1e6)  # millions USD

# ---------- 4) Add tariff event lines  ----------
tariff_events <- tibble(
  event = c("Section 232 (25% effective)", "Recent Tariff (25% effective)"),
  date  = as.Date(c("2018-03-23","2025-03-12"))  
)

```

```{r}

# ---------- 5) Plot ----------

library(ggplot2)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Rescale PPI index to fit import_value range
ppi_scaled <- scales::rescale(dat2$ppi_index,
                              to = c(0, max(dat2$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)),
                              from = c(min(dat2$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       max(dat2$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)))

dat2$ppi_scaled <- ppi_scaled

max_import <- max(dat2$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)
max_ppi    <- max(dat2$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot
library(scales)

p <- ggplot(dat2, aes(x = MONTH)) +
  
  # Bars for import value
  geom_col(aes(y = import_value), fill = "grey80", width = 25) +
  
  # PPI index line (already rescaled)
  geom_line(aes(y = ppi_scaled), color = "blue", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  # Tariff events
  geom_vline(data = tariff_events, aes(xintercept = as.numeric(date)),
             color = "red", linetype = "dotted",size=1) +
  geom_text(data = tariff_events, 
            aes(x = date, y = 0, label = event),
            angle = 90, vjust = 1.2, hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "red") +

  
  # Primary & secondary y-axes
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Monthly import value (USD millions)",
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),   # <-- format in millions
    breaks = seq(0, max_import, by = 80e6),    # 0, 50, 100, 150... million
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~ scales::rescale(., 
                                to = c(min(dat2$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       max(dat2$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                from = c(0, max(dat2$import_value, na.rm = TRUE))),
      name = "PPI Index (Jan 2018 = 100)",
      breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max_ppi/50)*50, by = 20)  # 0, 50, 100...
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b\n%Y", limits = c(as.Date("2018-01-01"), max(dat2$MONTH, na.rm = TRUE)),expand = c(0, 0))    +
  
  labs(
  title = "U.S. Monthly Imports: Flat-rolled steel (HS7208)",
  subtitle = paste0(
    format(as.Date("2018-01-01"), "%b %Y"),  # start
    " → ",
    format(max(dat2$MONTH, na.rm = TRUE), "%b %Y")  # end
  ),
  x = "Month and Year"
) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p



# Save plot
ggsave("steel_flatrolled_tariff_plot.png", p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
print(p)





```

#---------- Alumiunum
#===

```{r}
 
library(httr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

CENSUS_KEY <- # use personal census key  # Census key
fredr_set_key (" # Use FRED key")  

base <- "https://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs"
vars <- "GEN_VAL_MO,CON_QY1_MO,MONTH,COMM_LVL,I_COMMODITY"

# Parameters
hs4 <- "7606"   # Aluminum plates, sheets, strip >0.2 mm
start_ym <- "2018-01"
end_ym   <- "2025-08"

# Generate months
months_seq <- format(seq(ymd(paste0(start_ym, "-01")),
                         ymd(paste0(end_ym, "-01")),
                         by = "month"), "%Y-%m")

# Empty list
all_data_a <- list()

# Loop through months
for (month in months_seq) {
  qs <- list(
    get = vars,
    COMM_LVL = "HS4",
    I_COMMODITY = hs4,
    time = month,
    key = CENSUS_KEY
  )
  
  req_url <- modify_url(base, query = qs)
  res <- GET(req_url)
  stop_for_status(res)
  dat <- content(res, as = "parsed")
  
  if (length(dat) > 1) {
    data_rows <- dat[-1]  # drop header row
    all_data_a[[month]] <- data_rows
  }
}

# Combine
combined_data_a <- do.call(rbind, all_data_a)

# Column names
col_names_a <- c("GeneralValue", "ConsumptionQuantity", "MonthNum",
                 "CommodityLevel", "CommodityID",
                 "SourceCommodityLevel", "SourceCommodityID", "Time")

# Convert list -> dataframe
df_list_a <- lapply(combined_data_a, function(x) {
  as.data.frame(t(unlist(x)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

result_df_a <- do.call(rbind, df_list_a)
colnames(result_df_a) <- col_names_a

# Convert numeric
result_df_a <- result_df_a %>%
  mutate(
    GeneralValue = as.numeric(GeneralValue),
    ConsumptionQuantity = as.numeric(ConsumptionQuantity)
  )

head(result_df_a)



# ---------- 2) Clean and transform ----------

 
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

dat_a <- result_df_a %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert "YYYY-MM" to "YYYY-MM-01" and then to Date
    MONTH = ymd(paste0(Time, "-01")),
    import_value = as.numeric(GeneralValue),
    import_qty1 = as.numeric(ConsumptionQuantity),
    unit_value = ifelse(import_qty1 > 0, import_value / import_qty1, NA)
  ) %>%
  select(MONTH, import_value, import_qty1, unit_value) %>%
  arrange(MONTH)

head(dat_a)



```

```{r}
#  2) Get domestic PPI from FRED ----------
# Common PPI series for Industry level PPI for 
# PPI by industry: Semi conductor 

ppi_fred_id_a <- "PCU334413334413"   #  on FRED
ppi_a <- fredr(series_id = ppi_fred_id_a,
             observation_start = ym(paste0(start_ym)),
             observation_end   = Sys.Date()) %>%
  transmute(MONTH = as_date(date), ppi_a = value)

# ---------- 3) Merge and index to Jan 2018 = 100 ----------
start_base <- ymd(paste0(start_ym, "-01"))
# compute index base values
unit_base <- dat_a %>% filter(MONTH == start_base) %>% pull(unit_value) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)
ppibase   <- ppi_a %>% filter(MONTH == start_base) %>% pull(ppi_a) 

dat2_a <- dat_a %>%
  left_join(ppi_a, by = "MONTH") %>%
  mutate(unit_index = (unit_value / unit_base) * 100,
         ppi_index  = (ppi_a / ppibase) * 100,
         import_value_m = import_value / 1e6)  # millions USD

# ---------- 4) Add tariff event lines (manual edit needed) ----------
tariff_events_a <- tibble(
  event = c("Jan Tariff China (50% effective)", "Feb Tariff China (60% effective)"),
  date  = as.Date(c("2025-01-01", "2025-02-04")) 
)



library(ggplot2)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# 1. Compute linear scaling for PPI to match import_value range
min_import <- min(dat2_a$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)
max_import <- max(dat2_a$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)
min_ppi <- min(dat2_a$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)
max_ppi <- max(dat2_a$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)

dat2_a <- dat2_a %>%
  mutate(
    ppi_scaled_a = (ppi_index - min_ppi) / (max_ppi - min_ppi) * (max_import - min_import) + min_import
  )


max_import_a <- max(dat2_a$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)
max_ppi_a    <- max(dat2_a$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot
library(scales)

Polysilicon <- ggplot(dat2_a, aes(x = MONTH)) +
  
  # Bars for import value
  geom_col(aes(y = import_value), fill = "grey80", width = 25) +
  
  # PPI index line (already rescaled)
  geom_line(aes(y = ppi_scaled_a), color = "blue", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  # Tariff events
  geom_vline(data = tariff_events_a, aes(xintercept = as.numeric(date)),
             color = "red", linetype = "dotted",size=1) +
  geom_text(data = tariff_events_a, 
            aes(x = date, y = 0, label = event),
            angle = 90, vjust = 1.2, hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "red") +

  
  # Primary & secondary y-axes
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Monthly import value (USD millions)",
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),   # <-- format in millions
    breaks = seq(0, max_import, by = 4e6),    # 0, 50, 100, 150... million
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~ scales::rescale(., 
                                to = c(min(dat2_a$ppi_index_a, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       max(dat2_a$ppi_index_a, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                from = c(0, max(dat2_a$import_value_a, na.rm = TRUE))),
      name = "PPI Index (Jan 2018 = 100)",
      breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max_ppi/50)*50, by = 10)  # 0, 50, 100...
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b\n%Y", limits = c(as.Date("2018-01-01"), max(dat2$MONTH, na.rm = TRUE)),expand = c(0, 0))    +
  
  labs(
  title = "U.S. Monthly Imports: Polysilicon (HS280461) and PPI Index of Semiconductor (PCU334413334413)",
  subtitle = paste0(
    format(as.Date("2018-01-01"), "%b %Y"),  # start
    " → ",
    format(max(dat2$MONTH, na.rm = TRUE), "%b %Y")  # end
  ),
  x = "Month and Year"
) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

Polysilicon



# Save plot
ggsave("Polysilicon_tariff_plot.png", p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
print(Polysilicon)
```

#=== Coffee Price Model ===#

#==============#

```{r}
library(httr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

CENSUS_KEY <- # use personal census key  # Census key
fredr_set_key (" # Use FRED key")  

base <- "https://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs"
vars <- "GEN_VAL_MO,CON_QY1_MO,MONTH,COMM_LVL,I_COMMODITY"

# Parameters
hs4 <- "0901"   # Coffee)
start_ym <- "2018-01"
end_ym   <- "2025-08"

# Generate months
months_seq <- format(seq(ymd(paste0(start_ym, "-01")),
                         ymd(paste0(end_ym, "-01")),
                         by = "month"), "%Y-%m")

# Empty list
all_data_a <- list()

# Loop through months
for (month in months_seq) {
  qs <- list(
    get = vars,
    COMM_LVL = "HS4",
    I_COMMODITY = hs4,
    time = month,
    key = CENSUS_KEY
  )
  
  req_url <- modify_url(base, query = qs)
  res <- GET(req_url)
  stop_for_status(res)
  dat <- content(res, as = "parsed")
  
  if (length(dat) > 1) {
    data_rows <- dat[-1]  # drop header row
    all_data_a[[month]] <- data_rows
  }
}

# Combine
combined_data_a <- do.call(rbind, all_data_a)

# Column names
col_names_a <- c("GeneralValue", "ConsumptionQuantity", "MonthNum",
                 "CommodityLevel", "CommodityID",
                 "SourceCommodityLevel", "SourceCommodityID", "Time")

# Convert list -> dataframe
df_list_a <- lapply(combined_data_a, function(x) {
  as.data.frame(t(unlist(x)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

result_df_a <- do.call(rbind, df_list_a)
colnames(result_df_a) <- col_names_a

# Convert numeric
result_df_a <- result_df_a %>%
  mutate(
    GeneralValue = as.numeric(GeneralValue),
    ConsumptionQuantity = as.numeric(ConsumptionQuantity)
  )

head(result_df_a)



# ---------- 2) Clean and transform ----------

 
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

dat_a <- result_df_a %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert "YYYY-MM" to "YYYY-MM-01" and then to Date
    MONTH = ymd(paste0(Time, "-01")),
    import_value = as.numeric(GeneralValue),
    import_qty1 = as.numeric(ConsumptionQuantity),
    unit_value = ifelse(import_qty1 > 0, import_value / import_qty1, NA)
  ) %>%
  select(MONTH, import_value, import_qty1, unit_value) %>%
  arrange(MONTH)

head(dat_a)

#  2) Get domestic PPI from FRED ----------
# Common PPI series for Industry level PPI for 
# PPI by industry: Semi conductor 

ppi_fred_id_a <- "CUSR0000SEFP01"   #  on FRED
ppi_a <- fredr(series_id = ppi_fred_id_a,
             observation_start = ym(paste0(start_ym)),
             observation_end   = Sys.Date()) %>%
  transmute(MONTH = as_date(date), ppi_a = value)

# ---------- 3) Merge and index to Jan 2018 = 100 ----------
start_base <- ymd(paste0(start_ym, "-01"))
# compute index base values
unit_base <- dat_a %>% filter(MONTH == start_base) %>% pull(unit_value) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)
ppibase   <- ppi_a %>% filter(MONTH == start_base) %>% pull(ppi_a) 

dat2_a <- dat_a %>%
  left_join(ppi_a, by = "MONTH") %>%
  mutate(unit_index = (unit_value / unit_base) * 100,
         ppi_index  = (ppi_a / ppibase) * 100,
         import_value_m = import_value / 1e6)  # millions USD

# ---------- 4) Add tariff event lines (manual edit needed) ----------
tariff_events_a <- tibble(
  event = c("Baseline Tariff (10% effective)", "Brazil Tariff (50% effective)"),
  date  = as.Date(c("2025-04-05", "2025-08-07"))  
)



library(ggplot2)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# 1. Compute linear scaling for PPI to match import_value range
min_import <- min(dat2_a$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)
max_import <- max(dat2_a$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)
min_ppi <- min(dat2_a$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)
max_ppi <- max(dat2_a$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)

dat2_a <- dat2_a %>%
  mutate(
    ppi_scaled_a = (ppi_index - min_ppi) / (max_ppi - min_ppi) * 
                   (max_import - min_import) + min_import
  )

max_import_a <- max(dat2_a$import_value, na.rm = TRUE)
max_ppi_a    <- max(dat2_a$ppi_index, na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot
library(scales)

coffee <- ggplot(dat2_a, aes(x = MONTH)) +
  
  # Bars for import value
  geom_col(aes(y = import_value), fill = "grey80", width = 25) +
  
  # CPI line (already rescaled)
  geom_line(aes(y = ppi_scaled_a), color = "blue", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  # Tariff events
  geom_vline(data = tariff_events_a, aes(xintercept = as.numeric(date)),
             color = "red", linetype = "dotted", size=1) +
  geom_text(data = tariff_events_a, 
            aes(x = date, y = 0, label = event),
            angle = 90, vjust = 1.2, hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "red") +
  
  # Primary & secondary y-axes
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Monthly import value (USD millions)",
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"),   # format in millions
    breaks = seq(0, max_import_a, by = 100e6),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~ (.-min_import) / (max_import - min_import) * 
               (max_ppi - min_ppi) + min_ppi,
      name = "Coffee CPI Index (Jan 2018 = 100)",
      breaks = seq(floor(min_ppi/10)*10, ceiling(max_ppi_a/10)*10, by = 10)
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b\n%Y",
               limits = c(as.Date("2018-01-01"), max(dat2_a$MONTH, na.rm = TRUE)),
               expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Monthly Imports: Coffee (HS0901) and CPI Index of Coffee (CUSR0000SEFP01)",
    subtitle = paste0(format(as.Date("2018-01-01"), "%b %Y"),
                      " → ",
                      format(max(dat2_a$MONTH, na.rm = TRUE), "%b %Y")),
    x = "Month and Year"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

coffee




# Save plot
ggsave("coffee_tariff_plot.png", p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
print(coffee)
```
